_comment: 78 Tarot kartının mottosu — English, birinci tekil şahıs

cards.name: The Fool
cards.affirmation: I step boldly into the unknown; I accept every moment as full of new beginnings.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.affirmation: With my strength and will, I make everything I think come true.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.affirmation: I navigate the sea of inner wisdom; my intuition guides me.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.affirmation: I am surrounded by the abundance of nature; I am the source of creativity and abundance.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.affirmation: I rule with order and authority; I steer with confidence and determination.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.affirmation: In the infinite depth of wisdom, I find inner peace and guidance that illuminates my path.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.affirmation: Guided by my heart, I embrace love and harmony and join the dance of my life.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.affirmation: With my determination and willpower, I overcome every obstacle and freely direct my own destiny.

cards.name: Strength
cards.affirmation: I discover the infinite power within me and overcome difficulties with love.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.affirmation: In silence, I find my inner light and open new paths with wisdom.

cards.name: The Wheel of Fortune
cards.affirmation: In the cycles of fate, in the wind of change, I rise bravely; no matter what happens, my path is illuminated.

cards.name: Justice
cards.affirmation: I seek the truth with honesty and balance on the scales of justice; the truth always illuminates my path like a bright light.

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.affirmation: When I pause and reflect, I discover new perspectives in the universe with inner peace; I wait with patience and grow with understanding.

cards.name: Death
cards.affirmation: Every ending is a new beginning; I accept it, and as I let go of the old, I embrace brand new lives.

cards.name: Temperance
cards.affirmation: With the balance of peace, I harmoniously blend the fire within me; I move forward with patience and find the balance.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.affirmation: I emerge stronger from my dark confrontations; I choose to liberate my addictions.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.affirmation: Even if old structures collapse, I create a new me from the ashes.

cards.name: The Star
cards.affirmation: I am inspired by the stars of hope and guided by the universe.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.affirmation: I illuminate the truths behind the shadows and secrets with my intuition.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.affirmation: I shine in my own light and spread the power within me all over the world.

cards.name: Judgement
cards.affirmation: Rising from the ashes, I find my own truth; I resurrect myself with the fire within me.

cards.name: The World
cards.affirmation: I spin in harmony with the rhythm of the world; I accept the gift of completion and wholeness.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.affirmation: By igniting the fire of creativity, I step boldly into new beginnings.

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.affirmation: I look to the horizon, I know that discoveries and possibilities are limitless; I boldly realize my plans.

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.affirmation: I expand my horizons and move forward with determination to turn my vision into concrete reality.

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.affirmation: In the moment of success and celebration, I shine in my heart with the light of fire.

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.affirmation: The fire of competition makes me strong, I overcome obstacles with courage.

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.affirmation: As I savor the victory, I am driven by the fire of leadership in me.

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.affirmation: As I continue my defense with passion, I reach the summit with determination.

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.affirmation: My thoughts and actions quickly harmonize, I flow towards my goal.

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.affirmation: I am resilient, I get up stronger after every blow.

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.affirmation: My burdens are heavy but my goal is clear; I will successfully complete this path.

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.affirmation: I boldly venture into new horizons with my curiosity and passion for adventure.

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.affirmation: I rush forward with the power of fire, blending my passion with courage.

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.affirmation: I am the leader of my own light; I inspire others with my inner fire.

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.affirmation: I burn with fire, I lead with courage; I pursue my passions.

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.affirmation: Love overflows from the depths of my heart; I open to new beginnings in the sea of emotions.

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.affirmation: We are stronger together; love brings us together, unites our souls.

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.affirmation: I am full of the joy of celebrations; sharing with friends makes life meaningful.

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.affirmation: I dive deep into my inner waters and find new meanings beyond dissatisfaction.

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.affirmation: I let go of the weight of the past, accept the losses and set sail for new hopes.

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.affirmation: In the light of memories, I nurture my inner child with love and draw strength from the past.

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.affirmation: In the sea of dreams, I make my choices with wisdom and become free from illusions.

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.affirmation: I courageously continue my inner journey with everything I have left behind.

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.affirmation: I am overflowing with gratitude, with the peace of having my wishes fulfilled.

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.affirmation: I find peace with my family and loved ones; I am the architect of a world full of love.

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.affirmation: I bravely embrace creativity and imagination from the bottom of my heart.

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.affirmation: As a knight of love and emotions, I follow the voice of my heart.

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.affirmation: I reign with wisdom and compassion in the deep waters of my emotions.

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.affirmation: By mastering my emotions, I rule as a balanced and effective leader.

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.affirmation: I create new beginnings with the sharpness of my mind and wield truth like a sword.

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.affirmation: I find balance in my mind and choose to overcome difficulties with inner peace.

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.affirmation: I draw strength from the brokenness, I am reborn in the depths of my heart.

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.affirmation: I rest my mind and find peace in the depth of silence.

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.affirmation: I understand the cost of victories and focus on maintaining my own inner peace.

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.affirmation: I leave my mind to the wind of tranquility and sail towards calm waters.

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.affirmation: I use my intelligence to overcome obstacles and strategize.

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.affirmation: Even though I feel imprisoned, I discover my inner strength to find the path to freedom.

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.affirmation: With courage that transcends the night, I turn dark thoughts into light.

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.affirmation: I reach the end of pain, I am reborn from my ashes.

cards.name: Page of Swords
cards.affirmation: I seek the truth with the sharp sword of my consciousness, my thoughts are free as the wind.

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.affirmation: My heart full of courage, I take strategic steps even in the midst of storms.

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.affirmation: I rule with reason and intuition; I light the way with the light of clarity.

cards.name: King of Swords
cards.affirmation: I do justice with my wisdom and am firm and resolute in my thoughts.

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.affirmation: I deepen my roots and embrace abundance with the opportunities the universe offers me.

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.affirmation: I skillfully adapt to the changing rhythm of life; flexibility and balance are my guides.

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.affirmation: I achieve wealth and success through cooperation and joint efforts; I rise together.

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.affirmation: I feel the power of staying safe, but I dare to open up to grow.

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.affirmation: Even on dark days I find my way with my inner light; hope merges with determination.

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.affirmation: Generosity and balance enrich me; I multiply by sharing.

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.affirmation: I patiently grow the fruits of my labor and turn my dreams into reality with the power of the soil.

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.affirmation: Every meticulous detail is a reflection of my mastery and determination.

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.affirmation: In my own garden I find peace and abundance and enjoy freedom.

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.affirmation: I am building a future rooted in the legacy of my family and my past.

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.affirmation: With my passion for learning, I create new beginnings and pursue my dreams with determination.

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.affirmation: With patience and determination, I build a solid foundation at every step; success is with me.

cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.affirmation: I am surrounded by abundance and security; I enrich my world with inner peace and compassion.

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.affirmation: With wisdom and leadership I rule; with material power I ensure permanence in my world.
